title: Kitten reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Kitten body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="72" rx="22" ry="18" fill="#F4A23A"/>
  <!-- Kitten head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="42" r="20" fill="#F4A23A"/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <polygon points="33,30 28,12 42,22" fill="#F4A23A"/>
  <polygon points="67,30 72,12 58,22" fill="#F4A23A"/>
  <!-- Inner ears -->
  <polygon points="35,28 31,17 41,24" fill="#FAD7B0"/>
  <polygon points="65,28 69,17 59,24" fill="#FAD7B0"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="40" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#3D8B37"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="40" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#3D8B37"/>
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="40" rx="2.5" ry="3" fill="#102040"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="40" rx="2.5" ry="3" fill="#102040"/>
  <circle cx="43.5" cy="38.5" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="59.5" cy="38.5" r="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <polygon points="50,46 48,48.5 52,48.5" fill="#E8707A"/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d="M50,48.5 Q47,52 44,50" stroke="#C45A5A" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>
  <path d="M50,48.5 Q53,52 56,50" stroke="#C45A5A" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/>
  <!-- Whiskers -->
  <line x1="30" y1="44" x2="38" y2="46" stroke="#FAD7B0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="30" y1="48" x2="38" y2="48" stroke="#FAD7B0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="70" y1="44" x2="62" y2="46" stroke="#FAD7B0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="70" y1="48" x2="62" y2="48" stroke="#FAD7B0" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <!-- Book cover -->
  <rect x="30" y="62" width="40" height="24" rx="2" fill="#D64545"/>
  <!-- Book spine -->
  <rect x="48" y="62" width="4" height="24" fill="#F0C040"/>
  <!-- Book pages left -->
  <rect x="32" y="64" width="16" height="20" fill="#FFF8E8"/>
  <!-- Book pages right -->
  <rect x="52" y="64" width="16" height="20" fill="#FFF8E8"/>
  <!-- Page lines -->
  <line x1="34" y1="68" x2="46" y2="68" stroke="#D8C8A8" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="34" y1="72" x2="46" y2="72" stroke="#D8C8A8" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="34" y1="76" x2="46" y2="76" stroke="#D8C8A8" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="68" x2="66" y2="68" stroke="#D8C8A8" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="72" x2="66" y2="72" stroke="#D8C8A8" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="76" x2="66" y2="76" stroke="#D8C8A8" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Paws holding book -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="80" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#F4A23A"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="80" rx="6" ry="4" fill="#F4A23A"/>
  <!-- Paw toes -->
  <circle cx="27" cy="78" r="1.5" fill="#FAD7B0"/>
  <circle cx="31" cy="77" r="1.5" fill="#FAD7B0"/>
  <circle cx="73" cy="78" r="1.5" fill="#FAD7B0"/>
  <circle cx="69" cy="77" r="1.5" fill="#FAD7B0"/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d="M72,82 Q88,84 84,70 Q82,62 76,66" stroke="#F4A23A" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Tail stripes -->
  <path d="M84,76 Q86,80 82,83" stroke="#E88A20" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Head stripes -->
  <line x1="50" y1="24" x2="50" y2="30" stroke="#E88A20" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="44" y1="25" x2="46" y2="30" stroke="#E88A20" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="56" y1="25" x2="54" y2="30" stroke="#E88A20" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
